title: Hom to single coefficient square
statement: Let (C,J) be a site and R a sheaf of commutative rings whose underlying ring sheaf is defined by sheafCompose. Let L be an integer cochain complex of R-module sheaves, N,N′ R-module sheaves and g:N→N′. Write H=Hom(L,-) [def-pur-hom-complex], S=single(-,0), and D for the signed internal dual [def-sc-signed-sheaf-dual-complex]. There exist complex isomorphisms a:H(S(N))≅D(L,N) and b:H(S(N′))≅D(L,N′) satisfying H(S(g))≫b.hom=a.hom≫D(L,g), where D(L,g) is [new-g3-signed-sheaf-dual-coefficient-map]. No freeness or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Use the same chosen Hom projections for N and N′. The private helper homComplex_to_single_components constructs each chain isomorphism with its degree-k component equal to projection to p=-k followed by the singleObjXSelf internal-Hom map. It proves invertibility by the product universal property and differential compatibility by the projection differential formula.

Apply the projection map formula to id_L and S(g). Extensionality of complex morphisms, the helper component formula and homObjMap_comp_homObjMap reduce the square to postcomposition in degree zero. The natural singleObjXSelf maps identify this with g.

mathlib_searches.query: internal Hom complex into a single object naturally is the signed dual complex
Internal Hom into a single sheaf is naturally the signed dual and finite free dual sheafification commutes with coefficient quotients

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_to_single_coefficient_square
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
    {R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}}
    (L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ)
    (N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    (g : N ⟶ N') :
    let H := (homComplexFunctor (R := R)).obj (op L)
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) 0
    ∃ (a : H.obj (S.obj N) ≅ signedSheafDualComplex (R := R) L N)
      (b : H.obj (S.obj N') ≅ signedSheafDualComplex (R := R) L N'),
      H.map (S.map g) ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ signedSheafDualCoefficientMap L g
